WITH plan_trip_stats AS (
    SELECT
        p.plan_id,
        p.plan_name,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS member_count,
        COUNT(t.trip_id) AS trip_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.member_id) AS active_member_count,
        AVG(t.duration_sec) AS avg_trip_duration_sec,
        AVG(t.distance_km) AS avg_trip_distance_km,
        MAX(t.fare_cents) AS max_fare_cents,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.promo_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(t.trip_id), 0) AS promo_trip_ratio,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.end_station_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_trip_count,
        CASE
            WHEN COUNT(t.trip_id) = 0 THEN 'no_trips'
            WHEN AVG(t.duration_sec) >= 1800 THEN 'long_rides'
            WHEN AVG(t.duration_sec) >= 900 THEN 'medium_rides'
            ELSE 'short_rides'
        END AS duration_profile_label
    FROM plans AS p
    LEFT JOIN members AS m
        ON m.plan_id = p.plan_id
    LEFT JOIN trips AS t
        ON t.member_id = m.member_id
    GROUP BY
        p.plan_id,
        p.plan_name
)
SELECT
    plan_id,
    plan_name,
    trip_count,
    ROUND(
        trip_count * 1.0 / SUM(trip_count) OVER (),
        4
    ) AS trip_share_of_all_plans,
    member_count,
    active_member_count,
    ROUND(
        active_member_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(member_count, 0),
        4

    ROUND(avg_trip_duration_sec, 2) AS avg_trip_duration_sec,
    ROUND(avg_trip_distance_km, 2) AS avg_trip_distance_km,
    max_fare_cents,
    ROUND(promo_trip_ratio, 4) AS promo_trip_ratio,
    open_trip_count,
    duration_profile_label
FROM plan_trip_stats

WITH active_station_capacity_by_borough AS (
  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.is_active = 1 THEN s.capacity ELSE 0 END) AS active_capacity,
    SUM(s.capacity) AS total_capacity_all_stations
  FROM boroughs AS b

    ON s.borough_id = b.borough_id
  GROUP BY
    b.borough_id,
    b.borough_name
),

  SELECT
    b.borough_id,
    COUNT(t.technician_id) AS technician_count
  FROM boroughs AS b

    ON t.depot_borough_id = b.borough_id
  GROUP BY b.borough_id
),
borough_rates AS (
  SELECT
    a.borough_id,
    a.borough_name,
    COALESCE(tc.technician_count, 0) AS technician_count,
    a.active_capacity,
    a.total_capacity_all_stations,
    CASE
      WHEN a.active_capacity > 0
        THEN 1.0 * COALESCE(tc.technician_count, 0) / a.active_capacity

)

  borough_id,
  borough_name,
  technician_count,
  active_capacity,
  total_capacity_all_stations,
  technicians_per_active_capacity,
  SUM(technician_count) OVER (
    ORDER BY technicians_per_active_capacity DESC, borough_name
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS running_technician_count,
  SUM(active_capacity) OVER (
    ORDER BY technicians_per_active_capacity DESC, borough_name
    ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

    WHEN SUM(active_capacity) OVER (
      ORDER BY technicians_per_active_capacity DESC, borough_name
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

      THEN 1.0 * SUM(technician_count) OVER (
        ORDER BY technicians_per_active_capacity DESC, borough_name
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

      / SUM(active_capacity) OVER (
        ORDER BY technicians_per_active_capacity DESC, borough_name
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW

    ELSE NULL
  END AS running_technicians_per_active_capacity
FROM borough_rates
